input.supersedes: coffee_analysis.csv (2,095 rows, 2017-2022) and simplified_coffee.csv are strict subsets by name+roaster (1,982 of 2,095 matched); coffee_review_raw_texts.csv is the unparsed twin. Only coffee_reviews_parsed.csv is ingested.

registry_coverage_on_ingested_forms.note: Lower than the 6,396 / 56-of-56 pre-measurement because that scanned the whole Blind Assessment paragraph; ingestion takes only the extracted descriptor-list sentence and passes it through B2.normalize. The five words absent from list sentences (they occur in prose) return under parser v2.

yield_v1.comparison: licensed corpus 181 groups; unlicensed ACE ledger 1,420; this family alone 4,670 records with >=2 registry words

1990s.format: free narrative prose (Davids' early style). Not honestly extractable by pattern; needs the semantic cleaner or is accepted as loss.

2000s.format: mostly prose; 179 carry 'Aroma:'-style labels; 961 have >=3 commas but many are prose commas.

2010s.format: mixed: colon-introduced lists ('round aroma: toasted almond, cocoa-toned caramel...') and prose.

2020s.format: ready-to-drink reviews use a bare list sentence without the 'in aroma and cup' anchor: 'Rhubarb, Pinot Noir grape, cocoa nib, honeysuckle, sandalwood.'

patterns_to_add: bare list sentence: >=3 comma-separated short noun phrases, no finite verb, terminated by a period
colon-introduced list: '<noun> aroma|flavor|notes: X, Y, Z'
parser_v2_scope.must_not_add: any pattern that admits prose; every v2 atom must be a list item, never a clause
parser_v2_scope.measured_as: a separate batch with its own parser_version stamp and a delta against v1, never a silent replacement

public_sidecar_text_leak_check.narcissus_resolution: NOT A LEAK. All 10 hits are in source_url and source_locator, from the public review URL slug ethiopia-guji-narcissus-washed-g1 (a lot named Narcissus). Every family's sidecar publishes source_url. No descriptor text column is present in the public file.

restricted_ledger_integrity.note: wc -l overcounts by 38 because quoted newlines span lines; the file parses cleanly.

vocabulary_signal.reading: Direct gap-register material. Florals (magnolia, narcissus, honeysuckle, lilac, lavender, freesia) and woods (sandalwood, oak, fir) will mostly map to existing dimensions; apricot, date, maple/agave syrup, tangerine zest are candidate new specific concepts. 'narcissus 315' here is the descriptor form, distinct from the URL-slug coffee name.
